stories.title: Wyndham Championship Final Round — Hossler and Brennan Co-Lead at -16, FedExCup Playoff Lives on the Line
stories.angle: The 2026 Wyndham Championship is in its final round at Sedgefield Country Club in Greensboro, NC. Beau Hossler and Michael Brennan are co-leading at -16 entering Sunday. Tom Kim is one back at -15 after firing a 63 on Saturday. The FedExCup stakes are enormous: Hossler is ranked 122nd and needs a win to crack the top 70 and reach Memphis. Brennan (105th) needs at least a three-way tie for second. Brooks Koepka (86th) needs a solo 4th or better. Keegan Bradley, who has made 15 consecutive FedExCup Playoffs, barely survived the cut at 73rd. The playoff bubble resolves today. $8.5M purse, $1.53M to the winner.

stories.title: FedExCup Playoffs — St. Jude Championship Starts Thursday, McIlroy Headlines
stories.angle: The FedEx St. Jude Championship at TPC Southwind in Memphis begins Thursday, August 13 — four days from now. Rory McIlroy headlines the 70-player field, chasing a historic fourth FedExCup title (which would expand the all-time record he already holds). Scottie Scheffler enters as the No. 1 seed at 4,123 points. Defending FedExCup champion Tommy Fleetwood and defending St. Jude champion Justin Rose are also in the field. The top 70 will be officially confirmed tonight once Wyndham finishes.

stories.title: Scottie Scheffler — Five Second-Places, Zero Wins, 35 Consecutive Top-25 Streak Snapped
stories.angle: Scottie Scheffler enters the FedExCup Playoffs as World No. 1 and the points leader at 4,123 — yet he hasn't won since The American Express in January 2026. Five runner-up finishes (Masters, RBC Heritage, Cadillac Championship, Travelers Championship, 3M Open) and a missed cut at the Genesis Scottish Open — which snapped a remarkable 35-consecutive top-25 streak — define his season. He is dominant everywhere except the winner's circle.

stories.title: LIV Golf 2.0 — BC Partners Deal Advancing, Players to Become Majority Owners
stories.angle: Bloomberg and the Financial Times reported August 5 that BC Partners' credit arm is leading a $250-350M financing deal for LIV Golf's future. Players will become majority equity holders in the restructured league ("LIV 2.0"), tournament purses drop with compensation shifting to equity, and 10 events are planned for 2027. The deal is expected to close in September 2026, with Saudi Arabia's PIF pulling funding at the end of the year after investing approximately $5 billion since 2022. More than 12 additional minority investor parties are in discussions.

stories.title: LIV Golf New York — Niemann at -14 Leads Final Round at Trump National Bedminster
stories.angle: While the Wyndham wraps up the PGA Tour regular season, LIV Golf New York is playing its own final round at Trump National Golf Club, Bedminster, NJ. Joaquin Niemann led at -14 after 54 holes, with Harold Varner III at -12 after firing a stunning 65 in Round 3 to close the gap. Niemann went bogey-free for two straight rounds (64-65) before a 70 on Saturday. Torque GC holds a 5-shot team lead heading into Sunday.
